production_gaps.detail: All data stored in JavaScript Map. Lost on restart. Production requires PostgreSQL or equivalent.
No schema migration scripts. Production requires versioned, reversible migrations.
No rollback procedures. Production requires documented rollback plan per deployment.
Fastify logger=false. Production requires structured JSON logging with request IDs, error traces, audit events.
Miniapp requires WeChat platform review before production deployment with real AppID.
Payment callback is in-memory mock. Production requires real WeChat Pay / payment gateway with reconciliation.
